environment.description: EKS pod running in subnet with NAT gateway for S3 access. IAM role attached via IRSA with s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::* (wildcard). Kafka topic accepts messages from any authenticated producer. No VPC endpoint for S3 - traffic routes through NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint
config.runtime: EKS 1.28, Fargate profile, no network policy
